description.message: Saves images from Pinterest, Cosmos and any page into a moodboard folder in Downloads.

reason_browser_asks_where_to_save.message: the browser asks where to save: choose “Own folder…” in the extension window or turn off “Ask where to save each file” in the browser settings

connectHint.message: Needed once after each browser start

folderDenied.message: The browser did not allow writing. Check that sites may edit files in its settings and try again

folderIntro.message: Choose one folder for all boards. Each board becomes a subfolder in it, and saves go there without the browser asking where to save.

folderChosen.message: Done: folder “$name$”. Close this tab, open the extension and press “Connect folder”.

folderBlocked.message: The browser did not give access to this folder. Choose another one, for example a folder inside Downloads

folderUnsupported.message: This browser cannot save into a chosen folder. Saves go to Downloads

folderResetDone.message: Done: saves go to Downloads/moodboard-inbox again

reason_folder_not_connected.message: folder is not connected: open the extension and press “Connect folder”

reason_folder_missing.message: folder not found: choose it again in the extension

reason_folder_write_failed.message: could not write to the folder

reason_site_access_needed.message: the site does not give the picture to the extension
